infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: FitNFree uses speech recognition to turn your voice into text for your AI Coach.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: FitNFree uses your microphone for voice commands to your AI Coach and when you record videos.

plugins.photosPermission: FitNFree uses your photo library so you can choose photos and videos for equipment, meal and menu scans, form checks, trainer profiles and your private progress photos, which stay on your phone.
plugins.cameraPermission: FitNFree uses your camera to scan gym equipment, food barcodes, meals and restaurant menus, to record form-check and trainer videos, and to take private progress photos that stay on your phone.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: FitNFree uses your location to track outdoor activities like runs, walks, and rides.

plugins.motionUsagePermission: FitNFree does not use your motion activity. Apple requires this description because a location library used for outdoor tracking includes motion code.
